Jacques Peterson Part 2 - REHAB RACKET

By: Michael Duffett | Production

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Carte Blanche bust Peterson who forging court document - but he is still doing it.

Unique Selling Point:
Last year we featured Jacque Peterson the reformed drug addict who was making a living by forging court documents and hauling off addicts to treatment centres. Charges had been laid against him but the police had done nothing. He admitted to us that he forged documents. The senior prosector appeared on the program and said that documents were forged. We expected that he would now be arrested. No such luck. he has continued on his merry way - and now even manages a half way house for addicts and recently he called in a sex worker to thehalf way house. She alleges that he was high on tik, and that he did not pay her.

Summary:
We pick up from the re-cap pf the story. One man in October, after our program was aired, reports that he was "kidnapped`' by Peterson and against his will was taken to a rehab centre called House Rejuvenation where he spend a month in isolation.
Later, Peterson was in Cape Town where he illegally took a man by the name of Neville to a rehab centre in the Northern Cape. Here the addict was allegedly tortured by the manager Rob Green - and sexually assaulted. After this incident the centre was closed permanently and charges have been laid against Rob Green. it's alleged that Petersion filmed the sexual assault on his video phone. Then Peterson disappeared and its been reported that he underwent treatment at Noupport. Then he appeared again on FaceBook advertising that he now ran a half way house for addicts near Houghton.

This is problematic, for a recovering addict cannot be in charge of addicts so soon after his own treatment ended. Then while at the half way house, he called in a sex worker Trudi - sent a message to her to tell her to bring along TIK. She refused.
In his quarters at the half way house, she alleges that he took tik and became highly paranoid. He did not pay her for her serviced. She is irate.

Further information:
This is not a story abut the morality of people using sex workers. it is rather a story of a man who has carried on his criminal ways after being bust on CB. it's a story why police have not acted. it's a story of a man who continues to use drugs and is in charge of s half way house.

We remind viewers just what a man he is by recounting a story from the past - when he took an addict illegally from Durban to JHB and chained her up in his car and forced her to wear a nappy because she had a runny tummy. She remains traimatised by this incident and had to seek professional help to cope with the trauma at the hands of Peterson.

Script:


On the 15th of April Trudi Pelser a escort, received a call from a client requesting her services. Then followed his picture, his address and a message that read “plus lekka crystal” . She assumed that to mean - bring Crystal methamphetamine - a dangerous and addictive drug, She responded immediately:

Trudi:
“I am sorry, I don't do drugs – you are more than welcome to get them yourself – but I am not interested”

Masa:Who are we talking about?
Trudi: Jacques Peterson, of the Drug Squad.

In July 2019 we brought you the story of jacque Patterson who started the drug quad – it's aim: to assist families members whose loved ones were addicted to drugs . Now The Prevention and treatment of substance abuse act allows only for magistrates to commit a substance abuser who refuses treatment, to a rehabilitation centre, ... but the substance abuser must appear in court first. and only a court can issue a warren if the substance abuser fails to do so.

But unaware of how Peterson operated,, some families would pay him up to R10 000 and more to intervene. He simply circumvented the court process by forging committal orders and arrest warrants ...and he would sometimes arrive in the dead of night to apprehend substance abusers and take them to rehabilitation centres

Peterson was finally caught out by Frikkie Heefer, the owner of a rehabilitation centre near Potchefstroom, who laid charges against him. The senior prosecutor of the Randburg court Yusuf Babba studied several of Peterson's court orders and arrests warrants and confirmed  that they were all fraudulent.

When we caught up with him he denied any wrong doing.

Massa: Are you not apprehending addicts and taking them to centres without their permission?
Peterson: “ No...no Maam”

Then, after skipping an on-camera interview we had scheduled with him, Peterson sent us a (suprising) voice note:

Peterson: I do sometimes fake rehab orders, yes.

He did this, he said, because sometimes the court process took too long.

But Yusuf Babba had a strong message for Peterson.

Babba: if this man appeared before me, I would call for direct imprisonment

LINK
Despite charges being laid against him and admitting that he produced fake rehab orders,, Peterson was not arrested. You would expect by now he would at least act legally. Evidently not.

This 33 year old old man, we will call him Andrew,because he did not want his identity revealed, was addicted to drugs and spent 8 months last year at the Nieuwefontein Empowerment Centre, an unregistered rehabilitation facility in the Northern Cape. . After he left the centre , he relapsed and his concerned mother paid Peterson R10 000 to return her son to the facility., On the .25th of October Peterson and two colleagues arrived at a guest house in Cape Town where Andrew was staying. 

Andrew: so I asked them who they were and they said they were a drug unit from Kempton Police station.

Massa: what papers did they show you? Was it legal documents?

Andrew: He said that it was legal documents from a clinic in Joeburg but they didn't want to show me them.

Andrew felt that he had no choice but to get into Peterson's vehicle. The journey back to the centre back took 8 hours.Andrew had no idea of the fate that awaited him.

Link
What followed can only be described as a living hell.

Andrew: Jacques with his 2 colleagues came walking in with me. We were standing there....

Andrew said that the centre manager, who we can't name for legal reasons, forced him to wear a gagg which was covered in dog faeces. He was then ordered to strip in from of patients and staff.

Andrew: As I got to my pants Jacques stood up and said to Green that he had a brilliant idea – he took out his phone and started to record everything. I got undressed completely, they hand cuffed me 

He said that he was forced to wear a sack like garment and then was subjected to a brutal cavity search. . Next the centre manager demanded a urine sample , but Andrew said that he was unable to comply.(provide one)



Andrew: Then he took a taser and tasered me on my testicles.

A staff member who said he witnessed the tasering sent this voice message to andrew's mother a few days later 

Staff member: he still could not urinate so Rob thought he would force him ...he would stimulate hum. So he took a torch which was also a taser, and tasered him twice on the balls – Andrew fell to the floor screaming and crying:

Andrew said that Peterson was present through out his abuse on that Friday night: 

Andrew: he was making the loudest jokes and filming everything on his phone
Masa: Ddid he not at any point try to stop the abuse?
Andrew; no Maam, he motivated it.

He said that Peterson and his colleagues departed from the centre that same night. . Worse was to follow: He said the centre manager beat him, performed a another violent cavity search and sprayed him with a fire extinguisher.

WITNESS: and then he sprayed him with a fire extinguisher, and all the while Neville cried like a child, as if he saw somebody die.

Andrew was chained up to a wall in a Wendy house.

Andrew: Sunday morning around 2.30, he came back:

He said that the centre manager was drunk and had a bag full of sex gadgets.

Andrew: He started raping me from behind. 

After Andrew managed to escape this horror, his mother transferred him to another treatment centre. A staff member at the Nieuwefontain Empowerment centre reported the abuse to the owner of the property, Michael Clarke, who is also a director of the centre's operating company . He immediately summonsed the centre manager.
Owner: I suspended from any further duties, and I banned him from having any contacts with the residents...pending further investigations.

Clarke then took the decision to close the centre down. Andrew laid charges and the De Aar Family Violence ,child protection and sexual offences unit started investigating cases of rape and assault with intent to do grievous bodily harm against the centre manager - who denied all allegations when we spoke to him;
Green: “well I can just tell you that nothing what you have suggested took place”

He did not respond to our follow up letter requesting an interview or a written response to the allegations.

But on the 9th of July he was arrested in the Eastern Cape and last Monday appeared in the Hanover Magistrate Court. He remains behind bars till ..his bail application which will take place this week (this week) ( tomorrow)

We don't know if Peterson carried out any more of his interventions after this incident but we do know he posted a surprising message on social media.

APRIL

LINK
In May this year Peterson posted on his fracebook that he had decided to open a half way house in Houghton, adding, we cater for everybody and all prices are negotiable

And its to this address that escort Trudi was directed,. She said that Peterson told her that the property was a half way house for recovering addicts.
and she must pretend to be his administrative assistant. She obliged and then followed him into his room where she said he started using crystal methemphetamine..

Trudi: he had this lolly and every time he lit it he became so paranoid. – it was funny – he would jump up and look out of the window to see if anybody was watching.

Masa: So he definitely was high on drugs? Did you see him doing drugs?

Trudi: Oh yes, all the time, all the time

And adding insult to injury, she said Peterson never paid her.

Massa: so how much does he owe you?
Trudi: R2600!!

The owner of this property told us said that a half way house did not exist at this address and that Peterson had merely stayed over as a guest on a couple of occasions. 

But there's more! two months ago this mother, we will call her Jennifer, was discharged from hospital and came home to find that her son, who was addicted to drugs, was out of control and needed in patient treatment.

Mandy: And I realised that he is very sick and needed help

Just a few weeks ago, she paid Peterson R10 000 for an intervention but he did not arrive.

Mandy: I felt totally scammed as they would say..

Peterson had sent this document, a section 4 form to Jennifer to fill in. Tracy Helps, an expert in rehabilitation matters, said that this form did not give Peterson any authority.

Tracy: This is a form referred to as a section 4 form in terms of the Mental health Act. It allows for a family to complete it at a police station and it empowers a medic to pick up a patient and transport him to a psychiatric hospital, but only a psychiatric hospital.

We contacted Petersoin who seemed surprised to be hearing from us again.

Peterson. Am I in trouble?, let me put it this way because I was in trouble last year

he said that was acting now legally because he used the section 4 form. He also said the half way house didn't work out.

Peterson agreed to a on camera interview then we could not get hold of him but he was adamant that he was not present during Andrew's alleged abuse
 
(Peterson agreed to an on camera interview to respond to further allegations but we were then unable to get hold of him. He denied that he was present during Andrew's alleged abuse.) PREFER THIS TO THE ONE ABOVE BUT IT WONT FIT IN)

Peterson: We took him to to the rehab, where we left him, we don't stay to see what goes on, we see that he is booked in and we leave. 

His denial has angered Andrew who was traumatised after his alleged sexual assault, . He still has no clear idea of why he was targeted.

Andrew: I wanted to die, I was embarrassed , I was ashed, I am so angry with everybody

Massa : how aee you doing today?

Andrew: good... it's been a couple of months now.. my mother is a superstar – she is teaching me to take it day by day – hour by hour....minute by minute.

Andew has recently decided to lay criminal charges against Peterson for not trying to prevent the abuse he suffered.


Andrew; Luckily there are a few witnesses who can stand by me, who were there, how he was joking and recording everything on his phone.
